body:
## Summary
The focused draft legislation Playwright spec passes on desktop viewports but times out on the Pixel portrait project before it can reach the Legislation panel.

## Reproduction
1. Run `npx playwright test tests/e2e/draft-legislation.spec.ts`.
2. Watch the `chromium-pixel-portrait` project.

## Actual behavior
Desktop projects pass, but mobile portrait times out waiting for:

```ts
page.getByRole('button', { name: /^legislation$/i }).click()
```

The failure screenshot shows the dashboard with the mobile menu icon available, so the spec likely needs to open mobile navigation before selecting Legislation.

## Expected behavior
The draft legislation spec should navigate through the mobile layout and validate the drafting flow on Pixel portrait, matching the AGENTS.md screenshot/viewport requirements.

## Evidence
Observed while validating legislative drafting module work in commit `35e0656`. Desktop viewport projects passed; mobile portrait failed at navigation.

## Suggested fix
Update `tests/e2e/draft-legislation.spec.ts` or the shared navigation helper so mobile projects open the drawer/menu before clicking the Legislation route.

## Labels
- type:ui-regression
- area:legislation
- area:ui
title: Make draft legislation E2E spec work on mobile portrait navigation

body:
## Summary
Running the full Playwright suite currently fails before app assertions run.

## Reproduction
1. On branch `exp--legislative-overhaul`, run `npx playwright test`.
2. Observe startup failure before the suite reaches the app.

## Actual behavior
Playwright reports:

```text
Error: Cannot find module 'tests/fixtures/a11y-fixture' imported from tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts
Configuration Error: HTML reporter output folder clashes with the tests output folder:
html reporter folder: test-results/playwright-report
test results folder: test-results
```

## Expected behavior
The full E2E suite should boot cleanly, with reporter output stored outside the test artifact root or otherwise configured so reports do not clear artifacts.

## Evidence
Found while validating legislative drafting module work in commit `35e0656`.

## Suggested fix
- Restore or replace `tests/fixtures/a11y-fixture`.
- Move the HTML reporter output folder away from `test-results` or configure Playwright's output directory/report directory so they do not overlap.

## Labels
- type:bug
- area:ci
title: Fix Playwright suite startup fixture and reporter configuration
